I replied in the thread under your message in #strategic-pod.

Gideon's July 1 update has two numbers. He first posted 300 seats at 09:14, then corrected it at 09:19 to 280 active seats on the production roster, saying the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth's reply used 280, so 280 is the figure to put on the roster sheet.
